Players Committee card image of [[Velken Tezeri (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 2 to the power of anything he pilots. Smuggler. While present at a pit, adds 1 to your Force drains here. Unless 'hit' (or Gamall Wironicc here), your other characters here may not be targeted by lightsabers. May not target Luke with weapons.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual5-Dark/large/velkentezeri.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/53572eb94d14c4f21f0f3396874727653397c6e8 53572eb] (16 August 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is the latest version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
